target.title: fix: encode e2e npm registry package paths
target.body:
Related: CodeQL alert #562

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where the plugin E2E npm registry fixture encoded only the first `@` marker replacement path segment pattern, leaving unusual package names with additional slashes ambiguous in fixture metadata and tarball routes.

## Why This Change Was Made

The fixture registry now uses the same package path encoding shape as the packument report fix: percent-encode the package name, then restore only the leading scoped-package `@`. Regression coverage exercises both metadata lookup and tarball download for a package name with an extra slash.

## User Impact

Plugin E2E tests get a more faithful local npm registry fixture for scoped and unusual package names. There is no product runtime behavior change.

AI-assisted: yes, implemented with Codex.

## Evidence

- `pnpm format:fix -- scripts/e2e/lib/plugins/npm-registry-server.mjs test/scripts/plugins-assertions.test.ts`
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs test/scripts/plugins-assertions.test.ts`
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local`
- Autoreview result: `autoreview clean: no accepted/actionable findings reported`
- `git diff --check`
